maskingInfo.maskingDescription: This study does not involve treatment randomization so participants and all study personnel will be aware that participants are receiving CBIT. An Independent Evaluator will conduct pre-, post-treatment and 3-month follow-up assessments. This IE will be masked to information related to CBIT progress (e.g., visit attendance, specific content of sessions, therapist/supervisor perspectives on patient progress, CBIT session documentation). The IE will complete the primary outcome measure (YGTSS).
